name: ColdFusion - Directory Traversal (CVE-2010-2861)
description: Adobe ColdFusion 9.0.1 and earlier expose an unauthenticated directory traversal through the unvalidated locale parameter of several administrator .cfm files (CVE-2010-2861). Reading /lib/password.properties leaks the encrypted administrator password, which decrypts/cracks to the admin console - the pivot to authenticated RCE (scheduled task / FCKeditor upload).

variations.label: Manual traversal via the vulnerable locale parameter (no script)

examples.label: Copy the EDB script to the working dir
Read the admin password store (proves CVE-2010-2861)

notes: Vulnerable admin files all take a traversable locale param: CFIDE/administrator/settings/mappings.cfm, logging/settings.cfm, datasources/index.cfm, j2eepackaging/editarchive.cfm, CFIDE/administrator/enter.cfm. Target file /[cf_root]/lib/password.properties holds the SHA1/encrypted admin password (password=..., encrypted=true) plus rdspassword. On CF8 the hash is an unsalted SHA1 of the admin password - crack it, log into /CFIDE/administrator/, then get RCE via a scheduled task or the FCKeditor upload (see coldfusion-unauth-rce). Windows path uses ColdFusion8\lib; on Linux adjust the traversal depth to reach the install root. Also covered in: OSCP PEN-200 (Web Application Attacks).

recommended.note: Fingerprint the ColdFusion version first - this CVE is <=9.0.1.
After cracking the leaked admin hash (or directly), go for code execution.
Try default/leaked creds against the admin console.

defense.prerequisites: Adobe ColdFusion 9.0.1 or earlier reachable over HTTP (default 8500). No credentials required - the vulnerable administrator .cfm files are pre-auth.
defense.why_it_works: The locale parameter of several administrator .cfm pages is passed to a file read without path canonicalization or validation, so ../ sequences escape the intended directory and read arbitrary files as the ColdFusion service account.
defense.misconfiguration: Unpatched ColdFusion (<=9.0.1) with the /CFIDE/administrator/ console exposed to the network; the locale parameter accepts traversal sequences.
defense.impact: Arbitrary file read as the CF service user. Reading /lib/password.properties yields the admin console password (unsalted SHA1 on CF8), which grants admin access and, through it, remote code execution.
defense.detection: Web access log: GET to mappings.cfm / enter.cfm / index.cfm with locale= containing ../ or encoded ..%2f. Requests to password.properties. IDS signatures for CVE-2010-2861.
defense.artifacts: Access-log entries with traversal in the locale parameter; reads of password.properties; scanner User-Agents hitting /CFIDE/administrator/ paths.
defense.vulnerable_config:
# ColdFusion <= 9.0.1, /CFIDE/administrator reachable
# mappings.cfm?locale=<user input> -> file read, no canonicalization
defense.secure_config:
# Apply Adobe hotfix APSB10-18 (patches CVE-2010-2861)
# Restrict /CFIDE/administrator to internal IPs / VPN only
# Run CF as a low-privilege account; enforce an allowlist for locale values
defense.prevention: Patch to a fixed ColdFusion version (APSB10-18). Restrict the admin console to management networks. Canonicalize and allowlist the locale value. Run ColdFusion as a least-privilege service account. [MITRE M1050, M1042]
defense.evasion: URL-encode or double-encode the ../ sequence to slip past naive WAF signatures; vary traversal depth to reach the install root.
defense.code_review:
RED FLAGS (source): user input passed to include/require/file functions.
  include($_GET['page'])  |  require($base.$user)  |  file_get_contents($_REQUEST['f'])  |  fopen($path)
GREP:  grep -rniE "(include|include_once|require|require_once|fopen|readfile|file_get_contents|file\()\s*\(.*\$_" .
SAFE:  allowlist map of includable pages (basename + whitelist), open_basedir, allow_url_include=Off, no user input in path.
